```{r}
tcrs.joined <- tcrs %>% 
  filter(barcode %in% rownames(obs)) %>% 
  left_join(., obs %>% 
              select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype, tgroup) %>% 
              rownames_to_column("barcode"),
                  by = "barcode") %>% 
  relocate(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype, tgroup)

tcrs.joined
```

```{r}
tcrs.formatted <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(celltype == "TNKILC") %>% 
  mutate(length.TRA = nchar(cdr3.TRA)) %>% 
  mutate(length.TRB = nchar(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRA) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRA = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRA = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA), NA, count.TRA)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRB) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRB = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRB = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.TRB)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.Paired = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.Paired = ifelse(cdr3.Paired == "NA_NA", NA, cdr3.Paired)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.Paired) %>% 
  mutate(count.Paired = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.Paired = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA) | is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.Paired)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(biopsy, cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3mr = ifelse(length.TRB >= 12 & length.TRB <= 17, substr(cdr3.TRB, 5, nchar(cdr3.TRB) - 6), NA)) %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, tgroup, cdr3mr,
         ends_with("Paired"), ends_with("TRA"), ends_with("TRB")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    CellState = cellstate,
    CellSubtype = cellsubtype,
    TNKILC_Group = tgroup,
  )

tcrs.formatted
```

```{r}
alakazam <- read_csv("out/tcr/alakazam/cdr3b_mr_alakazam_scored_241120.csv")
alakazam
```

```{r}
tcrs.alakazam <- tcrs.formatted %>% 
  left_join(alakazam, by = "cdr3mr")

tcrs.alakazam <- tcrs.alakazam %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3mr)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(cdr3mr_aa_gravy, cdr3mr_aa_bulk, cdr3mr_aa_aliphatic, cdr3mr_aa_polarity),
      .fns = ~(ifelse(!is.na(cdr3mr), (. - mean(., na.rm = T))/sd(., na.rm = T), NA)),
      .names = "{.col}.norm"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Hydrophobicity = cdr3mr_aa_gravy.norm, Size = cdr3mr_aa_bulk.norm, Aliphatic = cdr3mr_aa_aliphatic.norm, Polarity = cdr3mr_aa_polarity.norm) %>% 
  select(cdr3mr, Hydrophobicity, Size, Aliphatic, Polarity) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3mr, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  left_join(tcrs.alakazam, ., by = "cdr3mr")

tcrs.alakazam %>% filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRB))
```

```{r}
alakazam.out <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  tcrs.alakazam %>% filter(timepoint == "T0" & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% droplevels,
  features = c("Hydrophobicity", "Size", "Aliphatic", "Polarity"),
  filterCol = "TNKILC_Group",
  filterVal = "CD4T",
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  yLab = "Mean AA Composition Score",
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, TNKILC_Group, denominator.freq, meanVal, featureVar) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(group = TNKILC_Group, group_count = denominator.freq) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy:group_count), names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

alakazam.out
```

```{r}
selectedparticipants.hla <- c("001-036", "001-038")

tirp.hla <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.tirp %>% filter(diagSub == "UC" & timepoint == "T0" & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% droplevels,
  features = "mTiRP",
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh"),
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  yLab = "Mean AA Composition Score",
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants.hla)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, DRB1, alleleNum, antitnf_response, timepoint, cellstate, denominator.freq, meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    mTiRP = meanVal, 
    group = cellstate,
    group_count = denominator.freq,
    `HLA-DRB1` = DRB1,
    Num_1501_Alleles = alleleNum,
  ) %>% 
  relocate(biopsy, diagSub, `HLA-DRB1`, Num_1501_Alleles,
           antitnf_response, timepoint,group, group_count, mTiRP) %>% 
  arrange(group, `HLA-DRB1`, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

tirp.hla
```

```{r}
expansion.out <- obs.tirp %>% 
  mutate(expanded.paired = case_when(
    count.Paired > 1 ~ "Expanded",
    count.Paired == 1 ~ "Singlet",
    is.na(count.Paired) ~ NA
  )) %>% 
  filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(count.Paired) & !is.na(cdr3MR)) %>% 
  mutate(expanded.paired = fct_relevel(expanded.paired, c("Singlet", "Expanded"))) %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, expanded.paired, cellstate, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(mTiRP, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(mTiRP, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, cdr3.Paired, count.Paired, expanded.paired, cdr3MR, mTiRP) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(expansion_group = expanded.paired) %>% 
  arrange(barcode)

expansion.out
```

```{r}
tirp.out <- rbind(

  tirp.celltypes,
  tirp.tfh,
  tirp.uc
) %>% distinct

tirp.out
```
